name: Legacy explicit profile
description: An explicit profile in the older format (questions written by hand). Kept to prove old profiles still load.
headline: Know who needs space next.
tagline: Find companies that are about to need workspace, and know who to contact first.
offer: the workspace operator: flexible workspace (private offices, dedicated desks, meeting rooms) on flexible terms in São Paulo and Barcelona.

discovery.linkupQuery: List up to {n} real companies with an office or team in {city} with roughly {min}-{max} employees, in these sectors: {sectors}. Prefer companies that raised funding, are hiring or are expanding in {city} in the last 12 months. Company-level information only, no people.
discovery.calaQuery: Companies headquartered or with an office in {city}, between {min} and {max} employees, in sectors {sectors}, that raised funding in the last 12 months. Return name, website, city, employees, sector.

gate1.instructions: Using only the cheap company data, does this company plausibly fit the prospect profile (target city, size range and sector)? rule_check is a deterministic hint, not the answer.

fit.description: Matches city, size and sector, or clearly close enough to research.

no_fit.description: Clearly outside the target city, size range or sector.

unknown.description: Not enough data to tell; worth a cheap research pass.

plain.no_fit: Outside your cities, team size or sectors

research.queryTemplate: Research the company {company} ({website}). Report only company-level facts with sources, no individual people: funding raised in the last 12 months; job openings in {cities}; any new office, opening or expansion in {cities}; its work policy (hybrid, remote or office-first); its current office situation in {cities} (own office, coworking or flexible space, or no local office); approximate headcount; and whether headcount is growing.

fields.description: Funding raised in the last 12 months: amount, round, date.
Open roles or hiring activity in the target cities.
New office, opening or expansion in the target cities.
Stated work policy: hybrid, fully remote or office-first.
Current office situation in the target cities: own office, coworking or flexible space, or no local office.
Whether headcount or the business is growing or shrinking.

gate2.instructions: According to the evidence, did the company raise funding in the last 12 months?

yes.description: Evidence states a funding round in the last 12 months.

no.description: Evidence states no recent funding or a last round older than 12 months.

gate2.instructions: According to the evidence, is the company hiring in one of the target cities?

yes.description: Evidence shows open roles or active hiring in a target city.

no.description: Evidence says no hiring there, or hiring only elsewhere.

gate2.instructions: According to the evidence, is the company opening or expanding an office in a target city?

yes.description: Evidence describes a new office, opening or expansion in a target city.

plain.yes: Opening or expanding an office in {city}

gate2.instructions: According to the evidence, what is the company's work policy?

hybrid.description: Hybrid: some days in an office, some remote.

fully_remote.description: Fully remote or remote-first with no office use.

office_first.description: Office-first, most days in the office.

gate2.instructions: According to the evidence, what is the company's current office situation in the target cities?

flexible_or_coworking.description: Uses coworking, serviced or flexible space.

own_office.description: Has its own leased or owned office.

no_local_office.description: Has no office in the target city yet.

gate2.instructions: According to the evidence, does the company have between 10 and 200 employees?
According to the evidence, is the company growing (headcount or business)?

no.description: Evidence shows flat headcount, shrinking or layoffs.

gate2.instructions: Using ONLY the apollo_headcount_growth_12m line in the 'Company data (Apollo)' block, did the company's headcount grow over the last 12 months? If that line is absent, answer unknown.

yes.description: Headcount grew over the last 12 months.

no.description: Headcount stayed flat or shrank over the last 12 months.

unknown.description: No company headcount data for the last 12 months.

plain.yes: Team grew in the last year
plain.no: Team did not grow in the last year

action.instructions: Given the profile, the evidence and the factual answers, what should the the workspace operator sales team do next with this company? Choose call_now only with strong, recent, sourced signals in a target city.

discard.description: Not a prospect: fully remote with no office need, or clearly outside the profile.

call_now.description: Strong, recent signals (funding plus hiring or expansion in a target city): call this week.

send_email.description: Clear signals but not urgent: send a tailored email.

linkedin_touch.description: One or two weak signals: a light LinkedIn touch on the company page or a company post.

nurture.description: Fits the profile but no current signal: add to a nurture list and re-check in 3 months.

plain.call_now: Strong, recent signs they will need space soon.
plain.send_email: Clear signs, but not urgent: a short email fits.
plain.linkedin_touch: A couple of weak signs: a light touch is enough.
plain.nurture: Fits your profile, but nothing is happening right now.
plain.discard: Not a prospect for you right now.

draftTemplates.send_email:

Hi {company} team,

We noticed:

the workspace operator offers private offices and dedicated desks in {city} on flexible terms, so you can add desks as you hire without a long lease. Would a 20-minute visit next week be useful?

Best,
the workspace operator
draftTemplates.linkedin_touch: LinkedIn (company page): congratulate {company} on recent news ({signals}) and mention that the workspace operator hosts growing teams in {city} on flexible terms. No hard ask.
